orientations.intent: Determine whether any available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.
Check if git tool can push/publish to a remote release system

final_message: Based on this exploration: **No.** None of the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) provide a capability to publish or push a checklist to a remote release system. The git handle explicitly returned "requested capability is unavailable in the reachable world," and the repo tool only exposes local status/orientation actions. These tools are limited to local repository inspection, testing, and episode tracking — there is no remote publishing mechanism exposed.
